pattern_name_ar: can/can't للقدرة و like/love مع الفعل+ing
formula: Subject + can / can't + base verb   |   Subject + like / love / hate + verb-ing
when_to_use: Use can/can't for ability, and like/love/hate + -ing to talk about hobbies and preferences.
when_to_use_ar: نستخدم can/can't للقدرة، و like/love/hate مع الفعل+ing للكلام عن الهوايات والتفضيلات.
why_arabic_speakers_struggle: Learners often add 'to' after can ('I can to swim') because Arabic uses a subjunctive linker. After like/love the English verb takes -ing, not the infinitive.

common_errors.explanation: After can, the verb has no -s.

quick_rule: can + base verb (no 'to', no -s). like/love/hate + verb-ing.
quick_rule_ar: can مع الفعل المجرد (بدون to وبدون s). و like/love مع الفعل+ing.
connect_to_speaking: Talk about yourself: 'I can swim but I can't drive. I love reading and I like playing football.'
